## Silver Dragon, Wyrmling (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
 LG Small dragon (cold)  
 **Init** +6; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +12  

**Defense**

 **AC** 20, touch 14, flat-footed 17 (+1 dodge, +2 Dex, +6 natural, +1 size)  
 **hp** 91 (7d12+7)  
 **Fort** +6, **Ref** +7, **Will** +9  
 **Immune** acid, cold, paralysis, sleep  
 **Weaknesses** vulnerability to fire  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 150 ft. (average)  
 **Melee** bite +10 (1d6+1), 2 claws +9 (1d4+1)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (20-ft. cone, DC 14, 2d8 cold), paralyzing breath  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 13, **Dex** 14, **Con** 13, **Int** 14, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 14  
 **Base Atk** +7; **CMB** +7; **CMD** 20 (24 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Weapon Focus (bite), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
 **Skills** Diplomacy +12, Fly +14, Heal +12, Intimidate +12, Knowledge (local) +12, Perception +12, Sense Motive +12, Spellcraft +12  
 **Languages** Auran, Common, Draconic  
 **SQ** change shape  

**Special Abilities**

 **Change Shape (Su)** A silver dragon can assume any animal or humanoid form 3/day as if using *polymorph*.  

 **Paralyzing Breath (Su)** Instead of a cone of cold, a silver dragon can breathe a cone of paralyzing gas. Creatures within the cone must succeed on a Fortitude save or be paralyzed 1 for 1d6 rounds plus 1 round per age category of the dragon.  

  

  

**Ecology**

 **Environment** temperate mountains  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** triple
